item.description: The Tyrone Township Board of Trust­ees unanimously approved to extend the Medical Marijuana (MMA) Caregiver Operations moratorium by 90 days. item.title: Fenton Township approves moratorium on data centers
item.description: Data centers are not allowed to be established in Fenton Township for at least one year. On Tuesday, Feb. 17, the Fenton Township Board of Trustees voted 5-0 to approve a 12-month, temporary moratorium on the establishment and use of data centers. Trustees Robert Kesler and William Clark were absent.
